1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif face at a comfortable size with roomy line spacing, though the dark 'Logs' panel uses a small monospaced font.

2.why: No italics or all-caps are used and every text unit is one short sentence rather than a dense paragraph.

3.why: Content sits in a single narrow, centred column with full-width stacked controls that would render well on a phone, although the log console adds an unnecessary block.

4.why: Instructions such as 'We can send one short code to your email or phone.' and 'Enter the 6 numbers when you are ready.' are brief and plain.

5.why: The verification field shows the placeholder 'Example: 123456' and the email field shows 'name@example.com'.

6.why: Every step presents only one or two short sentences before the action, with no long text blocks to read.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control appears anywhere; the flow stalls at the identity check and never reaches any secret or recovery codes to copy.

8.why: No QR code or scan alternative is shown in any screenshot because the authenticator setup screen is never reached.

9.why: Standard email/password/code inputs are used which could allow autofill, but no visible autocomplete hints, one-time-code affordance, or password-manager support can be confirmed from the screenshots.

10.why: A 'Step 2 of 4 · Check identity' banner and a solid blue filled button clearly mark position and the main action, though on later screens two blue buttons compete.

11.why: The code screen simultaneously offers 'Send code', 'Check code' and 'Send a new code', so more than one main action is presented at once.

12.why: Each action produces a plain confirmation such as 'Signed in. Next, check it is you.' and 'A code was sent. Enter the 6 numbers when you are ready.'

13.why: Retrying and requesting a new code are freely available with no lockout shown, but there is no reveal/hide control for codes and no recovery-code step is reached.

14.why: The error reads 'That code did not match. Check the 6 numbers or send a new code.' — it names the problem and the fix without blaming the user.

15.why: No countdown, timer, or expiry warning appears and messages say 'when you are ready', though no explicit statement of generous entry time is given.
